title.target: Modal passives and have something done
title.ko: 조동사 수동태와 사역: have something done
title.en: Modal passives and have something done

ex.t: My bike has to be repaired this week.

ex.t: I have my hair cut once a month.

title.ko: 조동사 + be + p.p. · have + 목적어 + p.p.
title.en: modal + be + past participle · have + object + past participle

explain.ko: 수동태에 조동사를 넣으면 '~될 수 있다 / ~돼야 한다'를 말할 수 있습니다. 형태는 조동사 + be + 과거분사입니다(It can be repaired. Cars must be checked.). have something done은 남이 해 준 일이나 시킨 일을 말할 때 씁니다. 형태는 have + 목적어 + 과거분사이며, 시제는 have가 나타냅니다(I have my hair cut every month. I had the roof fixed.). 직접 하는 일(I cut my hair)과 구분하세요.
explain.en: Add a modal to the passive to say what can or must be done: modal + be + past participle (It can be repaired. Cars must be checked.). Have something done talks about a service someone does for you or something you arrange. Form: have + object + past participle; have shows the tense (I have my hair cut every month. I had the roof fixed.). Compare with doing it yourself (I cut my hair).

head: 구조 / Structure
형태 / Form
예문 / Example
rows: Cars must be checked every year.

notes.ko: 직접 한 일이면 능동(I cut my hair), 남이 해 주면 have + 목적어 + p.p.입니다.
notes.en: Doing it yourself is active (I cut my hair); someone doing it for you is have + object + p.p.

notes.ko: have something done의 과거분사 자리에는 -ing가 아니라 p.p.가 옵니다.
notes.en: After the object use the past participle, not -ing.

notes.ko: 조동사 수동태에서 be는 항상 원형으로 둡니다.
notes.en: In modal passives keep be as the base form.

prompt.ko: 집이나 자전거 등을 수리할 때 필요한 일을 조동사 수동태와 have something done을 사용해 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about getting something repaired, using modal passives and have something done.

task.model: My bike has to be repaired this week. I'm going to have it fixed at the garage. The repair can be finished by tomorrow. The repair bill can be paid at the end of the month.

model_trans.ko: 내 자전거는 이번 주에 수리돼야 해요. 나는 정비소에서 그것을 고치게 할 거예요. 수리는 내일까지 끝날 수 있어요. 수리비는 월말에 지불될 수 있어요.
model_trans.en: My bike has to be repaired this week. I'm going to have it fixed at the garage. The repair can be finished by tomorrow. The repair bill can be paid at the end of the month.
